**Import convention:** All internal imports use `ufo.X` (e.g., `from ufo.galaxy.client.device_manager import ...`). Filesystem paths have **no `ufo/` prefix**.

## Key Packages

| Package | Purpose | Status |
|---------|---------|--------|
| `agents/` | Agent implementations (61 files, inheritance hierarchy) | Existing |
| `automation/` | **NEW** — `DesktopAutomation` protocol + Playwright/UIA backends | Phase 2 |
| `config/` | Config loading + DI container + secrets | Existing + Phase 4/11 |
| `galaxy/` | Multi-device constellation, web UI, device agents | Existing + Phase 8/14 |
| `llm/` | LLM providers, endpoint detection, **NEW** `LLMClient` protocol | Existing + Phase 12 |
| `module/` | Session pool, dispatcher, platform sessions | Existing |
| `terminal/` | **NEW** — modular widget terminal (split from `scripts/`) | Phase 3/7 |
| `telemetry/` | Audit logger, cost tracker, **NEW** OpenTelemetry bootstrap | Existing + Phase 15 |
| `trajectory/` | Parser, **NEW** SQLAlchemy models/repository | Existing + Phase 15 |

## LLM Client Protocol (Phase 12)

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class LLMClient {
        <<Protocol>>
        +complete(request: LLMRequest) LLMResponse
        +stream(request: LLMRequest) AsyncIterator~LLMResponse~
    }
    
    class BaseLLMClient {
        +_call_with_resilience(request: LLMRequest) LLMResponse
        # Uses module-level @RETRY + per-instance CircuitBreaker
    }
    
    class OpenAIClient
    class OllamaClient
    class GeminiClient
    class AnthropicClient
    class DeepSeekClient
    
    LLMClient <|.. BaseLLMClient
    BaseLLMClient <|-- OpenAIClient
    BaseLLMClient <|-- OllamaClient
    BaseLLMClient <|-- GeminiClient
    BaseLLMClient <|-- AnthropicClient
    BaseLLMClient <|-- DeepSeekClient
    
    note for BaseLLMClient "Resilience: tenacity.retry (module-level)\n+ pybreaker.CircuitBreaker (per-instance)"
```

## Observability & Trajectory (Phase 15)

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    LLMCall["LLM Client Call"]
    OTEL["OpenTelemetry\n(telemetry/__init__.py)"]
    Spans["OTLP Spans\n(grpc exporter)"]
    SQL["SQLAlchemy\n(trajectory/models.py)"]
    Repo["TrajectoryRepository\n(trajectory/repository.py)"]
    
    LLMCall -->|"auto-instrumented\nin BaseLLMClient"| OTEL
    OTEL --> Spans
    OTEL -.->|"span attributes\nsupersede or complement"| CostTracker["telemetry/cost_tracker.py\n(existing)"]
    OTEL -.->|"span attributes\nsupersede or complement"| AuditLogger["telemetry/audit_logger.py\n(existing)"]
    
    Session["Session/Step Events"] --> Repo
    Repo --> SQL
    Parser["trajectory/parser.py\n(existing)"] -.->|"ingestion path\ninto SQL store\nor retired"| Repo
```
